text: 油价持续飙涨引爆通胀忧虑，美股期指持续下跌，盘前光通信板块走低。 中国央行：坚持让市场在汇率形成中发挥决定性作用，不断增强汇率政策透明度。 美联储理事沃勒：加息无需在连续会议上进行，点阵图反映2027年初加息后再降息。 德国大幅上调2026年经济增长预期至1.3%，制造业复苏成关键支撑。 谷歌云发布Gemini通用工作代理：面向企业，一个窗口处理问答、创作与编程。 台积电三季度营收同比增长51%，AI基础设施建设需求持续强劲。 博通拟为OpenAI筹集300亿美元债务融资，AI算力扩张加速转向杠杆化。 Alphabet旗下AI 药物研发公司Isomorp
text_en: Surging oil prices ignite inflation concerns, US stock futures continue to fall, pre-market optical communications sector declines. PBOC: insist on letting the market play a decisive role in exchange rate formation, continuously enhance exchange rate policy transparency. Fed Governor Waller: rate hikes need not occur at consecutive meetings, dot plot reflects a rate hike in early 2027 followed by cuts. Germany sharply raises 2026 economic growth forecast to 1.3%, manufacturing recovery becomes key support. Google Cloud launches Gemini general-purpose work agent: for enterprises, handling Q&A, creation and programming in one window. TSMC Q3 revenue up 51% year-on-year, AI infrastructure construction demand remains strong. Broadcom plans to raise $30 billion in debt financing for OpenAI, AI computing power expansion accelerates toward leverage. Alphabet's AI drug discovery company Isomorp
